title: Dr Frost Arctic Mango Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Mango Pineapple Ice delivers the vibrant tropical flavours of juicy Mango and tangy Pineapple, finished with an icy menthol exhale. This lively and refreshing combination captures the perfect balance of sweetness and tartness, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy bold, exotic blends with a frosty twist. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, replicating the intense taste profiles associated with disposable vapes. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Mango Pineapple Ice Nic Salt is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, delivering smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Mango Pineapple Ice offers a versatile and satisfying vaping experience for adult smokers and vapers.
